name: mikebal/content-designer
description: An AI media director for WordPress drafts — reads a post like an editor, plans where a visual earns its place, generates it in your configured style, and places it. Built on the WordPress Abilities API, AI Client, and Interactivity API.

suggest.wordpress/wp-ai-client: Provider-agnostic AI client used for the editorial text pass when present (bundled in WordPress 7.0+).
